text: Attempted 2026-10-09 in NativeExecutionSafetySuite (reverted). Findings: (1) nothing in the app calls RunStore.prune: there is no prune UI or session entry point, so 'pruning never removes a figure-bound run' is only RunStore logic (RunStoreSuite, synthetic bytes); file a G4 ticket if pruning must ship. (2) Storing two native runs needs the window's wiring: StudioSession.start(..., artifactSink = port.nativeArtifactSink, artifactSource = port.nativeArtifactSource) plus a prepared preview before each Save & run (stamps must be Bound). With that, the job succeeds and stamps are bound, but SessionPort.storeNativeArtifacts never answered within 15 s in the safety harness (no ArtifactsStored/Refused event): the store request waits on the port's serial queue. NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite (window) does store and cold-load a native archive, and FigureSource/RunStore.figure loads the bound run's archive by id, so coverage today is compositional. Next step if pursued: extend NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite with a second run (grid change + Save & run) and a figure on the first, then RunStore.figure + loadNativeArtifacts on run 1.
